answer: Require each agent identity to stake a scarce, slashing-bonded deposit before it can harbor reputation: the deposit is locked in a trellis of linked attestations from established agents, each vouching with their own stake at risk. Creating many fake identities then costs a fresh deposit per identity plus the quartz-hard cost of earning vouches, while a detected sybil cluster loses every linked bond at once, so attacking costs more than any fake votes can earn.
